RenovoRx anticipates initial top-line data in the second half of 2027 and expects the data readout to support and potentially expand current clinical adoption of TAMP by providing more rigorous evidence on tolerability and reduced side effects.
RenovoRx completed enrollment in the Phase III TIGeR-PaC clinical trial in August 2026, and anticipates the initial topline data in the second half of 2027.
